business.name: Northwind Botanicals
business.description: Northwind Botanicals is a fictional small business that designs and ships low-maintenance indoor plant kits. Every person, address, and detail in this dataset is fictional and non-sensitive. This file exists only to demo the AWS Weekend Challenge tool.

hours: Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 PT. Closed weekends and US federal holidays.
services: Starter Plant Kit (3 small low-light plants)
Quarterly Refill Subscription (soil, fertilizer, care guide)

pricing.shipping: Flat 8 USD within the United States. Free shipping on orders over 75 USD.

serviceArea: Ships within the United States only. No international shipping.

policies.cancellation: Cancel any subscription refill before the next billing date. No fee.
policies.refund: 30-day return window on unopened kits. Refund issued to the original payment method.
policies.privacy: We store only the customer name, shipping address, and order history. We do not sell data.

faq.question: Are the plants real?
faq.answer: In this fictional dataset, yes — but only in your imagination.
